'''2007 Minnesota State Championship Josiah Benedict LS Tatooine''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Josiah Benedict]] at [[2007 Minnesota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine (Light) (Premiere)|Premiere-L-tatooine.gif|label=Tatooine}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
